faq.question: How long does international shipping take?
faq.answer: Shipping usually takes 15–25 days to the Middle East, 20–30 days to Europe, and 25–35 days to Africa or the Americas.

faq.question: Can you export to African countries?
faq.answer: Yes, we regularly export marble and granite to African nations including Kenya, Nigeria, Tanzania, and Ghana.

faq.question: Do you provide stone samples before bulk order?
faq.answer: Yes, stone samples are provided upon request before finalizing bulk orders.

faq.question: What quality certifications do you follow?
faq.answer: All products adhere to ISO and CE standards for quality and durability.
